test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the MISSPELT word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Assence"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is **"Essence".** (सार)

 
 
• **Example: **The **essence** of her argument was that we should care for the environment.
 
 
 
• **"Ascend"** means to go up or climb. (चढ़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **They watched the balloon** ascend **into the sky.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Assence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ascend** (चढ़ना): To go up or climb.

 
 
• **Example:** They watched the balloon ascend into the sky.
 
 
 
• **Exhale** (साँस छोड़ना): To breathe out.
 
 
• **Example:** She took a deep breath and exhaled slowly.
 
 
 
• **Escalade** (चढ़ाई करना): To climb or scale.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers escaladed the fortress walls.
 
 

39:Tbcf,

The correct answer is: Option 2<
